text:
mario: Procurement ran a quick vendor scan and ModelGate pitched an SRM (supplier risk mgmt) tool. They sent a quote and an integration doc. tagging @alice for budget.

alice: dropping the quote here — pricing looks seats + modules. need to confirm annual vs monthly.

jess (ModelGate): hi all 👋 shared the PDF: https://modelgate.com/redwood-quote. Core seat price $120/user/mo, add-on analytics $3k/mo, 1k integrations included. 20% discount proposed for annual. SOC2 + DPA available.

sara: can we switch to usage-based instead of per-seat? our team fluctuates a lot.

jess (ModelGate): we can offer a hybrid: base 10 seats + usage overage at $0.08/event. POC usage would be credited.

kevin: eng question — do they expose an events API? what are rate limits?

jess (ModelGate): yes REST + webhook. Rate limits: 1k rps per account by default, can increase w/ dedicated plan.

nina: security checklist: where is customer data stored? any EU regions? need data processing addendum + encryption at rest.

jess (ModelGate): we host in us-east and eu-west. DPA and encryption yes. We can sign BAA on request.

alice: finance note — target: annual commit for cost predictability. ask for deeper discount (30%) and a 6mo trial before PO. also need payment terms NET45.

mario: legal will need standard terms + indemnity language. can we get their standard SaaS agreement now?

jess (ModelGate): attaching standard SaaS T&C, can flag specific clauses. 30% discount is steep but we can do 25% for a 2-year commitment. Trial: 60-day trial for enterprise prospects.

kevin: POC request — can we get access to a staging tenant to run our connector (SAML + internal API)?

jess (ModelGate): yes, we can provision a staging org and temporary API keys.

nina: also confirm they do vulnerability scanning and will provide a pen test report.

jess (ModelGate): pen test report available under NDA. We run quarterly scans.

alice: ok summary: ask ModelGate for (1) updated quote with 25%/2yr pricing + NET45, (2) staging tenant + 60-day trial, (3) SaaS T&C + DPA + pen test report under NDA, (4) PO deadline and invoice cadence.

mario: @approvals-bot please route to finance for provisional approval (budget code FIN-OPS-23) once updated quote received.

approvals-bot: acknowledged — will create ticket FINREQ-412 and ping when updated quote lands.

kevin: once staging is up i'll run connector test and hit them with throughput benchmarks.

jess (ModelGate): will send updated docs by EOD tomorrow and include a sample PO template. thanks! :thumbsup:
